title: Rhythm & Micro-Timing Skill (REVISED)
revision_note: Now separates raw timing, quantized views, articulation evidence, rests, and look-ahead audio scheduling. Articulation rules are no longer broad deletion/snapping rules.
purpose: Make the melody sound human by preserving rubato, groove, phrasing and rests — with an explicit scheduling contract so the browser plays true durations.
core_principles: Humans do not sing exactly on the grid. Preserve micro-timing.
A melody with perfect grid timing sounds mechanical.
The expressive identity of a song lives in micro-timing, phrasing, and dynamic shape.

rubato.definition: Slight tasteful tempo deviation for expression.
rubato.action: Keep RAW onset times. A 20-50ms offset from the beat is musical, not an error. Do not re-quantize.

phrasing.definition: Grouping notes into musical sentences with a natural breath between phrases.
phrasing.action: Preserve rests. Shape velocities (swell toward phrase peak). A real gap = rest; do not fill it.

articulation.legato: Connected, overlapping notes when close in time with no breath.
articulation.staccato: Short detached notes for light passages.
articulation.action: Detect gap between consecutive notes: small gap -> legato (overlap); large gap -> rest. This is RENDERING, not a license to delete notes.

scheduling_contract.rule: Playback MUST schedule each note with its TRUE duration and absolute start time, not a fixed duration. Use a look-ahead Web Audio / Tone.js scheduler. Do not rely on HTML timeupdate for triggering fast notes.
scheduling_contract.note_off: Issue explicit note-off or use triggerAttackRelease with the true duration so holds, rests and staccato are faithful.
